fusions.name: Mile After Mile
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles. Its damage rises 3% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Heel to the Tread
fusions.desc: Stamps the blade into the ground with your boot, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Marching Camp
fusions.desc: Digs a camp ditch where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Metalled Way
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
